Хинетазон C10H12ClN3O3S = 289.7. CAS — 73-49-4. ATC — C03BA02. ATC Vet — QC03BA02. Profile Quinethazone is a diuretic that is related chemically to metola- zone and has properties similar to those of the thiazide diuretics (see Hydrochlorothiazide, p.1307).
